page: Microsoft Azure D2d_v4 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DDv4 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8272CL processor operating at 2.6 GHz. This configuration provides 2 vCPUs derived from a single physical core with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes a 77 GB local SSD for storage. The CPU cache architecture consists of 32 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 35 MB L3 cache, with support for advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and AES cryptography.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the D2d_v4 is positioned at the lower end of the compute spectrum. Multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth tests, such as stress-ng and PassMark, place the instance in the bottom 10% of tested hardware. Specifically, uncached memory read and write bandwidths are limited to 12.21 GB/sec and 8.99 GB/sec respectively. However, single-threaded tasks show moderate capability; both the Geekbench single-core score of 1173.0 and single-threaded gzip compression at 23.88 GB/sec fall within the average range. Software compilation, ray tracing, and image processing benchmarks remain low, reflecting the constraints of the dual-vCPU configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the D2d_v4 offers a low-cost entry point for workloads requiring dedicated CPU resources and local SSD storage without demanding high-density compute or memory. Due to its performance profile, it is best suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, small-scale development or testing environments, and simple single-threaded utility scripts. It is not recommended for database operations, large-scale LLM inference, or memory-intensive applications, as evidenced by its lower scores in database and Redis benchmarks.
description: The Microsoft Azure D2d_v4 is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine from the DDv4 family, running on Microsoft Hyper-V. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8272CL processor with 2 vCPUs (1 physical core, 2 threads) clocked at 2.6 GHz, 8.0 GB of RAM, and a 77 GB local SSD. While single-threaded performance is average—demonstrated by a Geekbench single-core score of 1173.0 and stable single-threaded compression—its multi-core and memory bandwidth capabilities fall into the lower percentiles. This resource profile makes the D2d_v4 a cost-effective option for lightweight, non-intensive applications. It is suitable for basic web serving, development environments, and small utility tasks, but is less optimal for database hosting or high-throughput data processing.
